s05021.summary: On a quiet night ward, Priya jinxes the calm and Albert scolds her.
Tomasz grumbles about texts from his wife about the sick dog.
Gloria praises the team's peace with an unnerving smile; the others whisper suspiciously.
Bleeding teenagers arrive and the staff barely react while Gloria watches the lot.
The Director phones to announce he's coming up, sending everyone scrambling.
Gloria admits the Director has watched them all night on camera.
The cleaner removes his cap and smiles, apparently the Director himself.

s05165.summary: In a flooded warehouse, Bogdan moves stock while a guarded woman keeps her bag.
With no signal, she doubts the driver will return; Bogdan offers peaches.
A distant horn; she offers her name, Ilse, and Bogdan almost smiles.
Soaked twin boys burst in looking for their mother.
Ilse wraps her coat around the boys and they share the peaches.
A message finally arrives asking about the boys, and Ilse shows them.

s05178.summary: Rhys makes weary Ellie sing her verse yet again in the booth.
Gran calls on speaker saying she's proud, and Ellie overhears, moved.
Rhys tells Ellie to sing with that feeling as the red light comes on.

s05030.summary: A woman watches new hire Teo scanning parcels at a rain-soaked warehouse belt.
She tells Teo the belt doesn't care; only whether he flinches matters.
Hands shaking, Teo keeps scanning and learns her name is Marguerite.

s05017.summary: Marcus and Rowan wait in a rainy parole office, trading weary remarks.
Mrs. Hale calls out the order of appointments.
The intercom orders Marcus back immediately and the lights die.
Marcus realizes the voice is somebody imitating Vance.
Rowan begs Marcus not to go; he says skipping means violation.
Mrs. Hale warns him off and reveals her thirty-year-old note: they come back.
Silence falls; a tall shape appears in the doorway, calling them all in.

s05062.summary: Driver Tasha questions her odd passengers: a runaway bride, her ex, and Bob.
Bob admits he got in the wrong car; the phone dies, no charger.
Ricky asks why they're not at church; Gwen admits she ran.
Bob compliments her dress; Gwen laughs and cries and takes his napkin.
Tasha pulls up at the church where the groom waves; everyone groans.

s05153.summary: In a packed esports arena, Wren waits frozen as the final round begins.
A nameless Player 2 joins with zero latency.
Hale insists something is wrong, asking why chat used her mother's name.
A chat message greets Wren; unplugging fails and the game plays on.
Every arena screen shows the corridor and the knight turns to camera.
Hale begs her to stand; Wren says it would get in.
Doors lock; Wren apologizes to her mother and picks up the controller.

s05145.summary: After the wedding, exhausted Gwen collapses; Ash enters with leftover champagne.
Gwen and Ash joke about the groom's uncle and the funeral-like wedding.
The DJ finds a song labeled do not play; Ash insists on it.
Eerie singing plays, candles light themselves, and the DJ denies pressing anything.
A veiled bridal figure appears in the doorway and steps toward them.
Ash proposes running, and they bolt out the side door.
The figure lifts its veil, revealing the grinning DJ pulling a prank.

s05094.summary: Alana slides Colm the evidence file; he calls its custody chain thin.
Alana urges Colm to file anyway; he refuses to risk the case.
Colm demands a notarized statement by Friday; Alana agrees and he reads.

s05102.summary: Robots Pim and Pip attend a lunar funeral reception under the dome.
Pim's clumsy eulogy draws Pip's correction and a silly retort.
The lights dim and the two robots admit they miss the captain.
Aunt Nebula rolls in late asking about cake and the captain.

s05049.summary: Marshal Reeves arrives at Sadie's food truck asking for a word with Cletus.
Reeves demands the payroll box; Jolene grabs a cleaver and exposes his warrant.
Sadie, brandishing a spatula, orders everyone to calm down and eat first.
The teenagers bolt, the dog barks, and brisket hits the dirt.

s05087.summary: During a power cut, Walter walks home late to Colleen in the dark kitchen.
Colleen recounts being pushed out after twenty-two years by a young manager.
Walter quietly reveals he got the same email, and Colleen finally looks at him.

s05014.summary: Nora makes small talk with a flat-voiced woman in a grey hoodie.
The twins chant about a smell; Nora blames rain, but it isn't raining.
The TV glitches and Dev reports everything has dropped; Vivian silences him.
The woman says she counts people, exits, and how long lights stay on.
The twins rise and point her out as arriving early.
Ilsa reveals herself, glowing, wanting one last manicure before the end.

s05185.summary: An undercover agent with a hidden camera sits in a church basement meeting.
Dana introduces herself as an alcoholic while Walter watches her hands.
Walter notes she sounds new and smells like gun oil.
A text warns he knows; Father Moran rises and orders Dana to drop the cup.

s05118_1.summary: Sasha cracks the safe while Aiden holds the light and Marlon watches.
They find the ring with a note of Okafor's unspoken apology.
Moved, they agree not to take it and return the ring.
Okafor arrives and catches them in the hallway.
Hearing they put it back, Okafor invites them in for tea.

s05171_0.summary: Rena narrates the heist plan as she and Bea move through a climate march.
Bea and Rena bicker over timing and who wrote the plan.
Police appear; Bea checks details and is alarmed the driver isn't present.
Under cover of the roar, Bea cuts the gate and they slip through.

s05024.summary: After the funeral, Odile watches Harlan drink as the family gathers silently.
Odile questions Harlan's alibi of being in Dover.
Teodor answers the hall phone; his tone turns sharp at the caller's words.
Rowan moves toward the hall and Odile warns them by name.

s05131.summary: Kestrel arrives late to a snowy warehouse meeting with Adrian.
Adrian wants the package; Kestrel demands who sold their name.
They stand off over package and name; Adrian drops a metal box.

s05196.summary: Jess and Theo meet on a rooftop, joking awkwardly about free food.
Jess confirms her Thursday flight and begs Theo to say something.
The argument escalates as Theo blames Jess for deciding without him.
Theo admits he doesn't want her to go; she's still going.

s05111_0.summary: At midnight, Riley records Priya's take eleven with tired engineer Cole.
Feedback, then an extra breath in the speakers; Priya senses someone with her.
Dez texts and says he's in the live room with Priya; she's alone.
The tape won't stop, the piano plays itself, and Dez warns before cutting out.
Outside, a dog panics and a delivery kid films; the lights die.
Trapped in the dark, Riley insists on going to Priya despite Cole.
The glass cracks and possessed Priya says take twelve.
Riley kicks the burning door open and drags Cole out before the blast.

s05068_1.summary: Ruth runs a routine check-in; Voss answers everything with fine.
Ruth raises his missed check-in and asks for a pay stub.
He hands over a boy's photo instead; Ruth says contact is forbidden.
Shaking, he insists it was mailed to set him up to violate.
Asked for a name, he asks to be called Calvin; Ruth says it.
Ruth promises he's not in trouble and leaves to make a call.

s05008.summary: Celia tells her father she's alone while a stranger follows her down the hall.
Her key card fails; the stranger steps closer offering help.
Marcus reminds her of the spilled gin; relieved, Celia hangs up on Dad.
Men emerge from the elevator; Marcus says they're after her father's debt.
The housekeeper sets down her cart and reaches into her pocket.

s05148_1.summary: Dev confronts the woman pulling at a cryo tank; she says power's failing.
Karen identifies herself as lab tech and enlists Dev to help lift.
Maya finds him; Dev says he's saving what they came for.

s05054.summary: Tess arrives late to the climate protest and Riley hands her coffee.
Abe fumbles with a megaphone he can't work.
Noor starts speaking and points: the harbour water has pulled far back.
Sirens and radio alarms; Gil orders everyone to move uphill to the library.
The crowd moves, signs drop, and Riley grabs Tess's hand to run.

s05034.summary: Four strangers chat idly while waiting on their laundry cycles.
Priya notes a man lingering outside by the bins.
A man in a dripping slicker brings in a heavy bag that shifts.

s05064_1.summary: Nate films down the hallway, joking nervously about the smell.
In Exam 1 he finds a chalked note and deep scratches in steel.
Claw taps echo from the hallway and Nate freezes.
His light finds a pale dog; he coaxes it until it bares wrong teeth.
Mo texts; Nate backs into the gurney with a crash, and the dog charges.

s05082.summary: On a packed train, Poppy shields hamster Biscuit while Marcus teases her.
The train jerks, the lights die, and it groans to a halt.
Transit worker Delilah calms the car and chats with the kids about Biscuit.
A clanging in the tunnel; Delilah keeps the siblings close.
Lights return, the train moves, everyone cheers, and Poppy thanks Delilah.

s05137.summary: On a foggy 1953 night bus, Walter collects fares and greets Edith.
Alistair notes the boy has no ticket; Tommy says his da is poorly.
Edith notices his worn cuff and pays Tommy's fare.
Alistair needles Edith and accuses her of abandoning Mrs Harcourt.
Edith asks who he is; Walter tells him to get off, he refuses.
Edith tells Tommy the man is only lonely, and Alistair cracks.
Alistair reveals Mrs Harcourt was his mother, who died calling Edith kind.
